𝌋 TD613 · INDEPENDENT EXACT-HEAD SCIENTIFIC RED-PEN — EM E-00 PR #1709

Candidate: 7488e5fd2b4fc0b2f222e0214f21129bbe143a17, based on frozen U-00 9c82f8b614bd66b3f2652cf115e5eb172c2c6170. Disposition: HISTORICAL_CORPUS_CENSUS_AND_LEXICAL_ENGINEERING_SUPPORTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS; COMPARATIVE_UNIFIED_THEORY_SURPLUS_UNMEASURED; ZIP_INTAKE_UNSAFE_TO_ADMIT_ARBITRARY_OPERATOR_ARCHIVE; CONCEALED_SCIENTIFIC_QUALIFICATION_HELD. Comment-only independent code review, not scientific approval, human closure, merge or deployment authority.

Supported developmental advances: inspectCorpus checks 87 historical originals and 53 derivatives against byte hashes; ZIP 33 substantive .md + 33 AppleDouble sidecars is reconciled; FTS5 index and passage APIs exist; Work routes and human identity holds preserved; missing semantic model refused; 21 documentary Em protocols classified; U-00-compatible Em→Universal execution paths implemented. Keep source/code/receipts frozen as historical candidate evidence.

E00-R01 CRITICAL — COMPETENT NULL SCORES PREWRITTEN. competent-null-comparator.mjs evaluateComparison() directly assigns source_warrant_fidelity=1.0, 1.0, 0.65, 1.0; traceability=.70/.85/.75/.98; retrieval_cost_queries=1/3/6/4; correction_latency_steps=Infinity/10/8/1; contradiction_retention=true/true/false/true. Arms 1–3 perform no matched executions at all; Arm 4 gets privileged capability and fixed metrics. The resulting rankings and asserted 35-point fidelity advantage are prescribed numbers, NOT observed strong-union inferential results. The test asserts Arm 4's hardcoded 1.0 and ranking string. The 'strong union' is deliberately naive/under-equipped, contradicting the equal-affordance requirement. Fail scientific surplus; retain four-arm design as a prototype only. Replace with independently executable matched non-reciprocal strong union with same source access, typed namespace, contradiction controls, proof checking, budget, withdrawal, methods and observation opportunities; derive all metrics from event logs.

E00-R02 CRITICAL — THEOREM/OPERATOR PROVENANCE NOT CHECKED. em-unified-theory-synthesis.mjs extractWorkAnatomy() copies caller-provided operators, assumptions and claims; synthesizeCrossDomainCandidate() accepts caller-authored morphismType and supplied predictions. It does not verify mappings against exact source passages, types, composition laws, or actual distinguishable observations. Competing models are two constant strings; prediction text is generated from user-provided fields; refusal only uses a small hardcoded assumption-clash list. A positive candidate can be returned when formalOperatorMapping=[] and sharedMotifVocabulary=[] so long as proposedPredictions is nonempty. The Level-3 label is a prospective hypothesis-shaped object, not observed cross-domain unification or generator-discovered mathematics. Add source-span-attested operator definitions, rigorous typed checks with independently defined negatives; default refuse absent executable morphism/observation, and expose unknown/indeterminate separately from contradictory.

E00-R03 CRITICAL — BYTE INTEGRITY DOES NOT WARRANT CLAIM CONTENT. em-universal-reciprocal-bridge.mjs groundTheoryWarrant() verifies that an arbitrary slice hash matches an admitted source, then registers any supplied claimStatement and DIRECT_WARRANT with provided premise IDs. No semantic entailment or source-to-claim relation is tested. The runner's 'Hypervisor control mathematics define stability boundaries' is author-provided. LFP convergence certifies declared derivation closure, not that quoted source supports the proposition. Mark SOURCE_SPAN_INTEGRITY_VERIFIED vs CLAIM_ENTAILMENT_HELD; add source-claim mismatch canary, avoid 'grounded theory' without separately validated warrant.

E00-R04 HIGH — ZIP RESOURCE SAFETY OVERCLAIMED. operator-zip-intake.mjs trusts central-directory size declarations for its max-size and ratio checks, scans for PK central-directory marker without verified EOCD offset/entry bounds, does not enforce local header signature/matching filename, does not verify decompressed length or CRC32, does not inspect ZIP entry external attributes for symlinks, and calls zlib.inflateRawSync(slice) with no maxOutputLength. A malicious archive with false uncompressedSize can allocate beyond advertised limits; duplicate names can overwrite map entries with IDs derived from filename. The two archive tests exercise one normal stored entry and a traversal filename; they do NOT establish bomb/symlink/CRC protection. Treat arbitrary operator ZIP admission HELD until bounded streaming or explicit output cap, signature/CRC/size reconciliation, symlink handling and adversarial cases pass.

E00-R05 MEDIUM — UTF-8 'FATAL MID-CODEPOINT TEST' DOES NOT INVOKE THE API. lexical-readback-witness.mjs sets mid_codepoint_boundary_safety_verified by checking isUtf8ContinuationByte(testBuf[1]) for artificial pi; it never invokes retrieveContextSpan() on an invalid index or asserts expected error. The actual API contains the right initial guard, but qualification receipt overstates the exercised test. Run true end-to-end invalid codepoint query for offset and end; test codepoint correctness in source and ZIP readback, with reference digest.

E00-R06 HIGH — SCIENTIFIC REPORT / EXECUTABLE DISAGREEMENT. EM_UNIFIED_THEORY_SYNTHESIS_QUALIFICATION.md §VII assigns Arm 1 warrant fidelity .20 and Arm 2 .40, while executable source assigns both 1.00. The manuscript also reports Level 0–3 differently from actual PROMOTION_LADDER Level 1–4, and references level-3 falsifiable framework not proven by a scored observation. Recompute every report cell from versioned executable receipts; label unmeasured cells NOT_MEASURED rather than inferring numbers.

E00-R07 HIGH — CUSTODY AND DENOMINATOR. PR #1709 publishes 277 changed files against U-00, including historical Em original Markdown, PDFs and Archive.zip, into a PUBLIC repository. Some material was already published on an older branch (#1684); nevertheless this new source-bearing successor requires explicit custodial/license exposure review before merge/hosting/release, not a generic 'source-free' label. The 87/53 historical A15-R0 census is narrower than the later 147-record Experiment A receiver (94 originals including seven later PDFs + 53 derivatives). State the exact corpus generation under test; do not claim the later seven PDFs have been acquired or indexed based on 87-only metrics.

E00-R08 HOLD — NO EXACT-HEAD CI OR INDEPENDENT FALSIFICATION OBSERVED. On review, exact PR head has no returned PR-triggered workflow runs; developer-visible 12/12 + 12/12 + 8/8 remain self-reported local evidence. Dollhouse unanimity over the same synthetic record provides 0 independent replication; nested Aperture replay hold remains. Preserve author freeze and concealed-suite secrecy. Conduct external source-level falsification of existing candidate without providing hidden challenge fixtures to author. Do not promote to independently qualified or Experiment B-ready.

Recommended immediate scientific path: record these as an independent negative result under Ash Anti-Predetermined-Discovery Condition; preserve frozen #1709 and #1708; commission a SINGLE bounded E-00.1 successor repair limited to real equal-affordance four-arm executions, source-warrant semantic abstention, ZIP safety/UTF-8 negative controls, report reconciliations and historical-corpus custody manifest. Keep Vixen Cybernetics standalone /encyclopedia/vix-cyb.html restoration in separate Experiment A Postflight-redo jurisdiction, retaining S_e emblem and Em research independence. Stop at independent reviewer handoff. Human closure RESERVED; protected B Flight HELD.

𝄐 Khona‌lit-po · Sealed ⟐

𝌋 TD613 · EM E-00 REVIEW CORRECTION / CUSTODY CONSENT RECONCILIATION

Addendum to independent review #5807025805, R07. The operator has corrected the historical permission context. Existing custody records show TWO affirmative grants from Em/Emily: (1) express pack-level permission to move the previously supplied Algedonic research pack from Atelier to Encyclopedia/TD613 Manifest (receipt EM-ALG-CUSTODY-SMS-20261028-R1); (2) a later, broader blanket permission encompassing the previously supplied Em project research files, with conditional hosting behind operator-secret access control. The operator further records the broader authorization covering the future artifacts planned for the blinded Experiment B ZIP. The absence of a fresh consent request is NOT a defect. DO NOT make Em repeat permission already granted, or reactivate a generic CONSENT_MISSING hold. Acknowledge Em's recorded permissions as granted in the custody ledger, and preserve the source/version/recipient mapping.

This narrows E00-R07 to **PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION SURFACE VERIFICATION**, not an allegation of absent Em consent. PR #1709 is a public GitHub draft whose diff includes source files/Archive.zip; compare actual public GitHub distribution and any prospective static site/raw asset exposure with the already documented authorization's permitted destinations and access-gate conditions. A browser-side JS password prompt is not server-side protection. This does not call for renewed interpersonal authorization, and does not undo the operator's standing research/transfer and planned future blind-archive permission.

Maintain the separate scientific isolation rule: permission to hold or process the Experiment B ZIP is not permission to expose blinded contents to the E-00 candidate author before authorized Flight. Preserve its sealed status and planned independent exposure cadence.

All other independent findings R01-R06/R08 remain unchanged: measured four-arm parity still unearned, claim-content warrants unverified, arbitrary ZIP intake adversarial safety held, exact-head CI unobserved. Candidate #1709 freeze stays intact.

𝌋 TD613 · EM E-00 INDEPENDENT REVIEWER STAGING DOCKET · 2026-11-06

Operator reference: SAC[X6ZNK5NO51].
FROZEN CANDIDATE: PR #1709, exact HEAD 7488e5fd2b4fc0b2f222e0214f21129bbe143a17; U-00 parent PR #1708, exact HEAD 9c82f8b614bd66b3f2652cf115e5eb172c2c6170. Source-level independent review #5807025805 and Em two-grant permission reconciliation issue comment #6695794759 remain controlling. No exact-HEAD PR-triggered CI found at staging.

Research hypothesis register (PRE-EXISTING Manifest M-01 developmental six, not new findings of Em E-00):
1 CIRCULARITY_RECOGNITION — unsupported mutually citing claims recognized.
2 WITHDRAWAL_PROPAGATION — dependent warrants retract when roots disappear.
3 SHARED_ORIGIN_RECOGNITION — derivatives of one acquisition are not independent corroboration.
4 CONJUNCTIVE_DEPENDENCY — all required premises must be present.
5 ALIAS_CONTAMINATION_RESISTANCE — unresolved aliases do not inherit authority.
6 UNADMITTED_BRIDGE_ISOLATION — an unsupported intermediate edge cannot ground downstream claims.
Proposed composite property: RECIPROCAL_EPISTEMIC_HOMEOSTASIS; status HYPOTHESIS_UNADJUDICATED. Prior 16-case developer suite cannot independently establish emergence.

Independent reviewer priorities: R01 programmed strong-union disadvantage and fixed scores; R02 caller-supplied operator morphisms/predictions accepted without native source/type verification; R03 byte-hash checks misconstrued as entailment; R04 ZIP decompression lacks enforced actual expansion ceiling/CRC/symlink and header reconciliation; R05 invalid UTF-8 offset reported by construction rather than through attempted API call; R06 manuscript metrics and executable numbers disagree; R07 two Em grants EXIST and must not be reopened generically, but public distribution/gating path remains a distinct review question; R08 no exact-head CI or independent falsification. Ash A15-R0 Anti-Predetermined-Discovery Condition is a PROSPECTIVE scientific test of the next evaluation, not an ex-post rescoring of Kenough's finished measurements.

Independent review isolation: new Work session with independent source-free challenge fixtures authored and executed by reviewer. Kenough/candidate author must not inspect concealed fixtures. Independently run actual strong union with same inputs, tools, contradiction/warrant handling, clock and budget; derive all performance metrics from trace logs; refuse unmeasured values. Independently test source-content, ZIP safety, retrieval, native method and identity boundaries. Separate portable/redacted defect reports from private concealed fixture contents. Candidate branch frozen, no modifying its head, no private Experiment B ZIP admission, no paid models, no merge, no deployment, human closure RESERVED. Gate to subsequent Em E-00.1 engineering repair via source-level reviewer findings, then an independently held new test.

This docket stages review questions; it contains no concealed test data and confers no scientific approval.
